Sled rental

Sled rental 3 minutes from Sinaia train station

Not everyone skis. For young children we have sleds at 40 lei a day, with a seat and belt for the littlest ones. Pick one up from us, 3 minutes from the station, and go sledding in Dimitrie Ghica Park, right in front of the centre. Your bags stay with us; in the evening you bring the sled back and head for your train.

Where to go sledding in Sinaia

Around town and in Dimitrie Ghica Park, the large park in front of our centre. Sleds aren't allowed on the gondola and there's no sledding run at the top, so a sledding day happens down in town: step off the train, pick up the sled, and in 3 minutes the kids are in the park.

What age

The sleds are for young children, from about 2 - 3 years up. For the smallest we have a seat that attaches to the sled, with a safety belt.

What to bring from home

Waterproof clothes, gloves, a hat. Children's helmets can be rented from us for 15 lei a day.

Frequently asked questions

Can I rent a sled for just a few hours?
No, sleds are rented by the day, 40 lei. Pick it up in the morning and bring it back by 18:00.
What age are the sleds for?
Young children, from about 2 - 3 years up. We also have a seat with a belt that attaches to the sled.
Can I take the sled up on the gondola?
No, sleds aren't allowed on the gondola and there's no sledding run at the top. Sledding is in town, in Dimitrie Ghica Park in front of the centre.
Can I book a sled online?
Yes, in the same form, enter the number of sleds.

Book a sled the evening before.

Enter the number of sleds in the form; everything goes out on WhatsApp.
